data.long_meaning: Rikki is derived from the Greek name 'Richelia', meaning 'powerful ruler'. In Greek mythology, Richelia was the name of a goddess who presided over the sun and the harvest. For Christians, Rikki represents a strong and independent woman with a gentle spirit. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rikki usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
